profile.headline: software engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience developing a broad range of quality software. Creative with strong analytical skills. Flexible contributor who has worn many different hats. Seeking a challenging and engaging project that will provide opportunities for growth.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led a small team of developers, DevOp specialists, and testers in developing OSO - a product which
pulls and post-processes various weather models from multiple sites in order to provide meteorological
forecasts. OSO needed to quickly identify serviceable sites while elegantly handling missing data, and
unreachable sites.
- Designed and developed the GOES-R Data Poller which polls satellite images from Madison to be processed by the RQTConverter, allowing IBM to provide satellite images to company product called MAX.

positions.title: software engineer
positions.description:
- Programmed and developed embedded software for the IR thermal device.
- Designed and developed the standalone application that interacts with the IR thermal device to showcase its various abilities and features.
- Worked as Release Engineer, developing the installation wizard for the standalone application and necessary device drivers.
- Worked as Tech Writer, writing the User's Guide and the Software Interface Control Document.
- Designed and developed the internal company website for the division.
- Worked on anti-tampering projects.
- Introduced and replaced the lossy floating point compression algorithm with lossless floating point compression algorithm for the entire Signal Image Processing Lab.
- Introduced and pushed for Mercurial as lab standard Source Code Revision Control.
- Assisted and supported imaging analysts in analyzing algorithms and in modeling.
- Built utility tools for the analysts.
- Worked as a tester for the early warning missile system.
- Responsible for programming the serial interfaces for the early warning missile system.

positions.title: KRS software engineer
positions.description: Programmed radar and optical tool applications. Assist Radar and Optical metric analysts in data reduction. Obtained secret clearance to work with classified material.

positions.title: Case Administrator
positions.description: Maintain Zantaz’s database to insure data integrity.  Repair and load the client data to the database. Provide technical support to clients. Create SQL and Perl scripts to meet clients’ demands.

positions.title: Student Project
positions.description: Designed and developed VPN testing procedures using bash shell scripts to collect network throughput and analyze the speed and effectiveness of different encryption standards- AES, 3DES, and Null (no encryption). Tested the encryption standards in different IPSec modes (tunnel and transport), and authentication methods (SHA-1 and MD5).
